info.headline: Village Halloween Parade - 10/31 (MN)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-30-2026 at 03:00 PM.
In support of the Village Halloween Parade, 6th Avenue between Canal Street and West 15th Street in Manhattan will be closed from 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM on Saturday, 10/31. Additional road closures in the surrounding area are possible. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
For more information, please visit: https://halloween-nyc.com To view this message in American Sign Language (ASL), العربية, বাঙালি, 中文, Français, Kreyòl Ayisyen, Italiano, 한국어, Polski, Pусский, Español, اردو or ייִדיש : http://on.nyc.gov/2gnTjHH.
